map.逐项判定：粘接强度≥1.0MPa、老化后强度保持率≥80%、环保达标率≥90%；: Item-by-item: adhesion ≥1.0 MPa, post-aging retention ≥80%, environmental ≥90%; all pass → qualified. Aging retention checks strength loss after thermal/moist aging and is a key durability metric.
map.粘接 1.5MPa（≥1.0 ✓）、老化保持率 85%（≥80 ✓）、环保 93: Adhesion 1.5 MPa (≥1.0 ✓), aging retention 85% (≥80 ✓), environmental 93% (≥90 ✓): all pass → qualified. If aging retention drops to 75% it fails, signalling insufficient durability — change adhesive.
map.结构胶长期受温湿循环，强度会衰减；保持率≥80% 表示老化后仍保留足够承载力，低: Structural adhesive endures temperature/humidity cycles and strength decays; ≥80% retention means enough capacity remains after aging, below which there is a structural-safety risk.
map.不够，还须看老化保持与环保；短期强度高但老化后骤降的胶不可用，三项须同时达标。: No — also check aging retention and environmental; a glue with high short-term strength but sharp post-aging drop is unusable. All three must pass together.
